focused.before: FAIL: ASCII85 data has no end marker.
focused.visualCheck: Both pages are blank and pixel-identical. The source page content stream has Length 0 with an A85 filter. This establishes recovery of that empty page, not restoration of damaged data elsewhere in the file.

behavior: Compatibility decoding accepts end of input instead of a missing ASCII85 end marker. Empty streams, complete tuples, and valid partial tuples are decoded normally.
preservedChecks: Strict end-marker requirements, invalid-byte and tuple validation, malformed explicit markers, 32-bit tuple overflow, and output-size limits are preserved.
limitations: Other byte corruption is not repaired. Single-file timing is not throughput; no updated full PDF.js count is claimed.
